CIEL HR Services financials show revenue growth and profitability trends over recent years, indicating business stability.

CIEL HR Services Limited provides a number of human resource services and technology solutions to meet the requirements of different kinds of industries. The human resource services of the company provide specific support with respect to recruitment and placement solutions, payroll processing solutions, human resource advisory solutions, and skill development solutions.The HR Tech platforms being offered by the company include: Talent Assessment and Development, Talent Engagement, Employee learning experience, Human Resource Management System, Fresher upskilling, and Statutory Compliance Management. · · The services offered in HR Services of the Company are as follows: · a. Professional Staffing · b. Value Staffing · c. Search & Selection & Recruitment Process Outsourcing · d. HR · · The company Ciel HR Services Limited has a customer base of 4,019. The major customers include Scootsy Logistics Private Limited, a wholly owned subsidiary of Swiggy Limited, Puma Sports India Private Limited, Niva Bupa Health Insurance Company Limited, Axis Bank Limited, Brigade Enterprises Limited, Blue Star Limited, and Aditya Birla Group, among others. · Thus, as on June 30, 2024, the group has (i) 49 business partners at 33 locations; and (ii) 67 offices in India out of which 49 offices have been opened and are operated by business partners, marking a strong presence in tier two and three cities, establishing itself significantly in the HR solutions market in India.
Pandiarajan Karuppasamy, Hemalatha Rajan, Aditya Narayan Mishra, Santhosh Kumar Nair and Doraiswamy Rajiv Krishnan are the company's promoters of CIEL HR Services.
